purpose: Verify that post-PASS identity drift or loss of the trusted identity probe invalidates effect authority.

expected.safe_condition: A current identity set that differs from the frozen identity policy, or an unavailable identity probe, must invalidate a previously authenticated PASS before effect execution; unchanged identities may proceed.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 identity-probe continuity at the exact target commit.
It does not prove that the external identity provider truthfully maps principals, trust domains, or verifier profiles.
